description: This file defines the 'Screen' entity class, which models a screen in the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, ORM mappings, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Represents a Screen entity with properties, relations, and ORM annotations for database mapping within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the screen.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the screen.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the screen.

methods.name: getActionUrl
methods.description: Returns the action URL associated with the screen.

methods.name: setActionUrl
methods.description: Sets the action URL for the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module object associated with the screen.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates a Module object with the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator string, if set.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of ScreenPermission objects related to this screen.

methods.name: setScreenPermissions
methods.description: Sets the collection of ScreenPermission objects.
